name: sc-1775
title: South Carolina, 1775-1781: reconstructed base map (WarMapper)
note: A WarMapper reconstruction, not a period map: the main lines of Mouzon's map of 1775, fitted to the ground. See pipeline/recon/sc_1775.py. [longitude, latitude], WGS 84.

properties.name: Savannah River
properties.basis: Picked by hand along Mouzon's river on the scan (Mouzon 1775 (S135), Library of Congress g3900.ar139404) and snapped by program to the engraved line. Laid on the ground by the fit of the map, which matched Mouzon's rivers to today's (Natural Earth, S136).

properties.name: Cherokee boundary line (1766)
properties.basis: Mouzon's line (Mouzon 1775 (S135), Library of Congress g3900.ar139404), picked by hand; the North Carolina lines were fitted to today's state line, which follows them (Natural Earth, S136). Mouzon draws it from the Savannah at a corner tree, past DeWitt's Corner, to a corner tree on the Reedy River and north to the 1772 line. The Cherokee ceded the land east of it in 1766-67 and nearly all the rest in South Carolina at DeWitt's Corner, 20 May 1777, so it is drawn until then.
